data.description: Container for an iOS-style segmented control. Direct child <button> elements become the segments. Dispatches `aed:segmented:change` events.

data-aed-segmented-name.description: Group name passed in change events. Useful when multiple controls coexist on the page.

data-aed-value.description: Value emitted in change events when this segment is selected.

data-aed-default.description: Mark this segment as initially active. If no segment has the flag, the first one wins.

api.description: Dispatched on the container. detail = { name, value, previous }.
